entries.name: Premium Bedroll
entries.text: During downtime, you automatically clear a Stress.

entries.name: Piper Whistle
entries.text: This handcrafted whistle has a distinctive sound. When you blow this whistle, its piercing tone can be heard within a 1-mile radius.

entries.name: Charging Quiver
entries.text: When you succeed on an attack with an arrow stored in this quiver, gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to your current tier.

rollOptions.label: Charging Quiver
rollOptions.description: Only a successful attack with an arrow stored in this quiver.

entries.name: Alistair’s Torch
entries.text: You can light this magic torch at will. The flame’s light fills a much larger space than it should, enough to illuminate a cave bright as day.

entries.name: Speaking Orbs
entries.text: This pair of orbs allows any creatures holding them to communicate with each other across any distance.

entries.name: Manacles
entries.text: This pair of locking cuffs comes with a key.

entries.name: Arcane Cloak
entries.text: A creature with a Spellcast trait wearing this cloak can adjust its color, texture, and size at will.

entries.name: Woven Net
entries.text: You can make a Finesse Roll using this net to trap a small creature. A trapped target can break free with a successful Attack Roll (16).

entries.name: Fire Jar
entries.text: You can pour out the strange liquid contents of this jar to instantly produce fire. The contents regenerate when you take a long rest.

entries.name: Suspended Rod
entries.text: This flat rod is inscribed with runes. When you activate the rod, it is immediately suspended in place. Until the rod is deactivated, it can’t move, doesn’t abide by the rules of gravity, and remains in place.

entries.name: Glamour Stone
entries.text: Activate this pebble-sized stone to memorize the appearance of someone you can see. Spend a Hope to magically recreate this guise on yourself as an illusion.

entries.name: Empty Chest
entries.text: This magical chest appears empty. When you speak a specific trigger word or action and open the chest, you can see the items stored within it.

entries.name: Companion Case
entries.text: This case can fit a small animal companion. While the companion is inside, the animal and case are immune to all damage and harmful effects.

entries.name: Piercing Arrows
entries.text: Three times per rest when you succeed on an attack with one of these arrows, you can add your Proficiency to the damage roll.

rollOptions.label: Piercing Arrows
rollOptions.description: Only a successful attack with one of these arrows.

entries.name: Valorstone
entries.text: You can attach this stone to armor that doesn’t already have a feature. The armor gains the following feature. Resilient: Before you mark your last Armor Slot, roll a d6. On a result of 6, reduce the severity by one threshold without marking an Armor Slot.

entries.name: Skeleton Key
entries.text: When you use this key to open a locked door, you gain advantage on the Finesse Roll.

entries.name: Arcane Prism
entries.text: Position this prism in a location of your choosing and activate it. All allies within Close range of it gain a +1 bonus to their Spellcast Rolls. While activated, the prism can’t be moved. Once the prism is deactivated, it can’t be activated again until your next long rest.

entries.name: Minor Stamina Potion Recipe
entries.text: As a downtime move, you can use the bone of a creature to craft a Minor Stamina Potion.

entries.name: Minor Health Potion Recipe
entries.text: As a downtime move, you can use a vial of blood to craft a Minor Health Potion.

entries.name: Homing Compasses
entries.text: These two compasses point toward each other no matter how far apart they are.

entries.name: Corrector Sprite
entries.text: This tiny sprite sits in the curve of your ear canal and whispers helpful advice during combat. Once per short rest, you can gain advantage on an attack roll.

entries.name: Gecko Gloves
entries.text: You can climb up vertical surfaces and across ceilings.

entries.name: Lorekeeper
entries.text: You can store the name and details of up to three hostile creatures inside this book. You gain a +1 bonus to action rolls against those creatures.

rollOptions.label: Lorekeeper
rollOptions.description: Only against one of up to three hostile creatures recorded in the book.

entries.name: Vial of Darksmoke Recipe
entries.text: As a downtime move, you can mark a Stress to craft a Vial of Darksmoke.

entries.name: Bloodstone
entries.text: You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn’t already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature. Brutal: When you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die.

entries.name: Greatstone
entries.text: You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn’t already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature. Powerful: On a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and discard the lowest result.

entries.name: Glider
entries.text: While falling, you can mark a Stress to deploy this small parachute and glide safely to the ground.

entries.name: Ring of Silence
entries.text: Spend a Hope to activate this ring. Your footsteps are silent until your next rest.

entries.name: Calming Pendant
entries.text: When you would mark your last Stress, roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, don’t mark it.

entries.name: Dual Flask
entries.text: This flask can hold two different liquids. You can swap between them by flipping a small switch on the flask’s side.

entries.name: Bag of Ficklesand
entries.text: You can convince this small bag of sand to be much heavier or lighter with a successful Presence Roll (10). Additionally, on a successful Finesse Roll (10), you can blow a bit of sand into a target’s face to make them temporarily Vulnerable.

entries.name: Ring of Resistance
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can activate this ring after a successful attack against you to halve the damage.

entries.name: Phoenix Feather
entries.text: If you have at least one Phoenix Feather on you when you fall unconscious, you gain a +1 bonus to the roll you make to determine whether you gain a scar.

entries.name: Box of Many Goods
entries.text:
Once per long rest, you can open this small box and roll a d12.

1–6: it’s empty.
7–10: it contains one random common consumable.
11–12: it contains two random common consumables.

entries.name: Airblade Charm
entries.text: You can attach this charm to a weapon with a Melee range. Three times per rest, you can activate the charm and attack a target within Close range.

entries.name: Portal Seed
entries.text: You can plant this seed in the ground to grow a portal in that spot. The portal is ready to use in 24 hours. You can use this portal to travel to any other location where you planted a portal seed. A portal can be destroyed by dealing any amount of magic damage to it.

entries.name: Paragon’s Chain
entries.text: As a downtime move, you can meditate on an ideal or principle you hold dear and focus your will into this chain. Once per long rest, you can spend a Hope to roll a d20 as your Hope Die for rolls that directly align with that principle.

entries.name: Elusive Amulet
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can activate this amulet to become Hidden until you move. While Hidden in this way, you remain unseen even if an adversary moves to where they would normally see you.

entries.name: Hopekeeper Locket
entries.text: During a long rest, if you have 6 Hope, you can spend a Hope to imbue this locket with your bountiful resolve. When you have 0 Hope, you can use the locket to immediately gain a Hope. The locket must be re-imbued before it can be used this way again.

entries.name: Infinite Bag
entries.text: When you store items in this bag, they are kept in a pocket dimension that never runs out of space. You can retrieve an item at any time.

entries.name: Stride Relic
entries.text: You gain a +1 bonus to your Agility. You can only carry one relic.

entries.name: Bolster Relic
entries.text: You gain a +1 bonus to your Strength. You can only carry one relic.

entries.name: Control Relic
entries.text: You gain a +1 bonus to your Finesse. You can only carry one relic.

entries.name: Attune Relic
entries.text: You gain a +1 bonus to your Instinct. You can only carry one relic.

entries.name: Charm Relic
entries.text: You gain a +1 bonus to your Presence. You can only carry one relic.

entries.name: Enlighten Relic
entries.text: You gain a +1 bonus to your Knowledge. You can only carry one relic.

entries.name: Honing Relic
entries.text: You gain a +1 bonus to an Experience of your choice. You can only carry one relic.

entries.name: Flickerfly Pendant
entries.text: While you carry this pendant, your weapons with a Melee range that deal physical damage have a gossamer sheen and can attack targets within Very Close range.

entries.name: Lakestrider Boots
entries.text: You can walk on the surface of water as if it were soft ground.

entries.name: Clay Companion
entries.text: When you sculpt this ball of clay into a clay animal companion, it behaves as that animal. For example, a clay spider can spin clay webs, while a clay bird can fly. The clay companion retains memory and identity across different shapes, but they can adopt new mannerisms with each form.

entries.name: Mythic Dust Recipe
entries.text: As a downtime move, you can use a handful of fine gold dust to craft Mythic Dust.

entries.name: Shard of Memory
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can spend 2 Hope to recall a domain card from your vault instead of paying its Recall Cost.

entries.name: Gem of Alacrity
entries.text: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Agility when making an attack with that weapon.

entries.name: Gem of Might
entries.text: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Strength when making an attack with that weapon.

entries.name: Gem of Precision
entries.text: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Finesse when making an attack with that weapon.

entries.name: Gem of Insight
entries.text: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Instinct when making an attack with that weapon.

entries.name: Gem of Audacity
entries.text: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Presence when making an attack with that weapon.

entries.name: Gem of Sagacity
entries.text: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Knowledge when making an attack with that weapon.

entries.name: Ring of Unbreakable Resolve
entries.text: Once per session, when the GM spends a Fear, you can spend 4 Hope to cancel the effects of that spent Fear.

entries.name: Belt of Unity
entries.text: Once per session, you can spend 5 Hope to lead a Tag Team Roll with three PCs instead of two.

entries.name: Alconite Crystal
entries.text: You can expend the energy in this crystal to gain a 1d4 bonus to a Spellcast Roll. You can recharge it as a downtime move by immersing it in salt water.

entries.name: Anchoring Hook
entries.text: When you make a reaction roll to avoid being moved against your will, you can deploy this anchor to gain advantage on the roll, and resistance to any damage you take from the movement.

entries.name: Ancient Runestone
entries.text:
Trace this forgotten rune with your finger and spend a Hope to roll a d6.

1: mark a Stress.
2–3: nothing happens.
4–5: you gain advantage on your next Spellcast Roll.
6: clear all Stress.

entries.name: Big Bug Begone
entries.text: Once per rest, point this giant beetle antenna at any giant invertebrate within Close range and force it to make a Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, it is permanently transformed into a normal-sized creature of the same kind.

entries.name: Bogglass Reed
entries.text: Once per rest, while holding this reed, you can take the spotlight when the GM spends a Fear. Craftinto: ChronoQuill.

entries.name: Bubble Wand
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can activate this wand with a successful Finesse Roll (10) to produce a stream of bubbles, giving disadvantage on the next attack against you. If the attack misses, you gain a Hope.

entries.name: Calming Censer
entries.text: This contraption disperses smoke that calms insects and other bugs up to Close range of you, giving them disadvantage on attacks for the scene. Once burned, it needs refilling with fragrant herbs.

entries.name: Croakroot Pad
entries.text: As a downtime move you can meditate on this pad to ask the GM a question about your past or future. Until your next rest you take 1d6 magic damage whenever you make an Insight Roll with Fear.

entries.name: Detuner
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can spend a Hope to activate the detuner. Any melody produced within Far range is disrupted. A creature creating a magical tune can mark a Stress to maintain it or it is forced to stop.

entries.name: Dread-Weave Boots
entries.text: While wearing these boots, you have resistance to any magic damage triggered by contact with the ground.

entries.name: Dreamer’s Shard
entries.text: During a long rest, you can use this crystal to induce a prophetic dream, giving a hint to a question that is worrying you. When you do this, you must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (14) or be trapped in a nightmare, paralyzed until someone wakes you. The shard shatters if you fail the reaction roll.

entries.name: Etheric Anchor
entries.text: While carrying this anchor you can mark 2 Stress to automatically succeed on a Reaction Roll against the effects of spatial distortions or other hostile geography.

entries.name: Flickerbloom
entries.text: While carrying this flower, you have advantage on Reaction Rolls to resist any temporal anomalies, but if you fail such a roll, you must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Gravitic Tether
entries.text: While wearing this belt, you take half damage from falls, and no damage from the effects of gravitational anomalies, but you can’t travel further than Very Close range on your move without an agility roll.

entries.name: Ice Gloves
entries.text: When you pick up snow with these gloves you can form it into a deadly snowball and throw it as a weapon (Agility, Close, mag d6+1).

entries.name: Jamming Spanner
entries.text: Make a successful Finesse Roll to place this tool into a machine to prevent it from operating. The GM can spend a Fear to break the spanner and restart the machine, or you can remove it with a second roll. If you make either roll with Fear, you take damage. The Difficulty and damage depend on the machine.

entries.name: Lantern of Shadows
entries.text: While using this lantern, you can see through any illusions and see secret doors and passageways within Close range. When you roll with Fear or when the scene ends, the lantern extinguishes, and can’t be lit again until you take a long rest.

entries.name: Lightning Scarab
entries.text: When you’re hit by electrical damage, you can divert it into this brooch, then roll your Duality Dice. If the total is less than the diverted damage, the brooch explodes and you take the sum of all the damage it has absorbed. The brooch safely discharges all stored damage during a long rest.

entries.name: Lovebugs
entries.text: A set of two ceramic bugs. When you place one on the floor, it will crawl toward the other by the fastest available route.

entries.name: Mimicry Mask
entries.text: While wearing this mask, once per scene you can mimic a creature within Close range. Until you are next spotlighted, they experience either delayed speech (must mark a Stress to speak), erratic movements (disadvantage on reaction rolls), or clumsy attacks (disadvantage on attack rolls).

entries.name: Pathfinder’s Ledger
entries.text: If you scribe your path into this book as you travel, you have advantage on rolls to navigate or avoid being disoriented. If you fail such a roll with Fear, you lose one piece of information you previously knew about your current path.

entries.name: Puddleduck’s Fins
entries.text: While wearing these fins on your feet, you must mark a Stress to move further than Very Close range on land, but you can move at normal speed when swimming. A druid wearing these fins can Beastform into an Aquatic Scout without marking a Stress.

entries.name: Pure Crystal
entries.text: Once per session, when you use a feature that restores HP to a creature, restore one additional HP.

entries.name: Quill of Memory
entries.text: You can write up to a hundred words with this quill as a downtime move. They don’t appear on the page but are etched into your mind. No effect can erase them, and you don’t need to make a roll to recall them.

entries.name: Red Nose of Hope
entries.text: While wearing this nose you have advantage on Presence Rolls to entertain an audience. Once per long rest, you can also mark a Stress to turn a roll with Fear into a roll with Hope.

entries.name: Rootslicer Gauntlet
entries.text: You have advantage on attacks and Reaction Rolls against plant-based creatures and hazards. Each time you use this feature and still fail the roll, the GM gains a Fear.

entries.name: Shadowangler Lure
entries.text: Once per rest you can activate this lure and cause it to glow. Any creature within Far range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (12). On a failure, they move in to Very Close range.

entries.name: Siren’s Rock
entries.text: Once per rest you can place this weathered and barnacle-laden stone in seawater. Creatures within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (12) or become temporarily Enraptured. Enraptured creatures can’t make attack rolls and must mark a Stress to move anywhere except toward the stone.

entries.name: Soulweave Cloak
entries.text: While wearing this cloak, once per long rest you can become Incorporeal, able to move through physical objects and resistant to physical damage, until you end the condition or the scene ends. Other incorporeal creatures have advantage on attacks against you while you are in this form.

entries.name: Spirit Seeker
entries.text: Hold out this willow wand and spend a Hope to sense the location of the nearest dead or undead creature larger than a cat within Far range. You can additionally mark a stress for each dead or undead creature you want to exclude from the search.

entries.name: Stingshield Robes
entries.text: While wearing these bug-resistant clothes and dont have any marked Armor Slots you are immune to damage by any creature up to the size of a bee, and resistant to damage from all creatures up to the size of a mouse. These robes regain their properties once you cleared your armor slots.

entries.name: Superior Alconite Crystal
entries.text: You can use the energy in this crystal to gain a 1d4 bonus to a Spellcast Roll. If you roll a 4, the energy is expended and it can’t be reused until you recharge it as a downtime move by immersing it in salt water.

entries.name: Tarrasque Sinew
entries.text: When you string a bow without a feature with this powerful cord, it gains the following feature. Titan-Slayer: You gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for damage rolls with this weapon when you hit a creature more than twice your size.

entries.name: Ticket Master’s Pouch
entries.text: The pouch can hold a handful of gold. When you use the gold from inside it to pay for something up to a bag of gold in value, you have advantage on Presence Rolls to haggle for the price.

entries.name: Timeglass
entries.text: Once per session, you can look through this spyglass as if looking through it in the same location some time in the past. You can set it to any length of time from 10 minutes to 10 days.

entries.name: Tome of Ancient Knowledge
entries.text: As a downtime project (7) you can read this book to permanently increase your Knowledge modifier by +1. Once you do this, the book’s pages turn blank.

entries.name: Tortoise Horn
entries.text: If you use this bony fragment as a pommel for a weapon that doesn’t already have a feature, the weapon gains the following feature. Concussive: When succeeding an attack roll, you can mark a Stress to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for that attack.

entries.name: Twisted Lens
entries.text: When you look through this lens, you can see into far distance through objects and terrain. However, everything you see is distorted and evil-looking. You must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (14). If you fail the roll you must mark a Stress and wont be able to make any sense of what you saw.

entries.name: Veilcloak
entries.text: While wearing this, you have advantage on Finesse Rolls made while in darkness. You can also spend a Hope once per long rest to make it shine with dim light up to Close range. Creatures outside that range must mark a Stress to see inside.

entries.name: Veilshroud Hood
entries.text: While wearing this cloak you have advantage on Reaction Rolls against illusions and being magically spied on, but disadvantage on rolls to perceive normal sights and sounds. Once you don the cloak, you must wear it until your next rest or it loses its powers.

entries.name: War God’s Sigil
entries.text: You can transfer this design onto armor that doesn’t have a feature. It gains the following feature: Herald of War: On your first attack in a scene, you can add your Presence to the attack roll.

entries.name: Winter Wolf Cloak
entries.text: While wearing this cloak, when you cause an adversary to mark 1 or more Hit Points, you can spend a Hope to increase your Evasion by 1 until you next take damage. You can’t stack this effect.

entries.name: Witherroot Charm
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can ignore all damage from a psychic attack. You then have disadvantage on Presence Reaction Rolls until you take a downtime move to purge the charm of psychic residue.

entries.name: Wolffriend Pendant
entries.text: While wearing this item, dogs and wolves will not attack you unless you are hostile towards them or their packmates, and you have advantage on rolls to befriend or influence them.

entries.name: Wraith Trap
entries.text: This box can hold up to three undead spirits. You can make a Finesse Roll to trap an undead creature, with a +1 bonus for every HP the target has marked. For each trapped spirit, you have a +1 bonus to reaction rolls against psychic attacks. You can open the box and release all trapped spirits.

entries.name: Yeti Coat
entries.text: While wearing this coat you take half damage from exposure to cold. In freezing temperatures, you can mark 3 Stress to transform into a Yeti for the scene as if using a Druid’s Beastform feature (use the Powerful Beast form).

entries.name: Potioncraft Kit
Alchemy Jug
entries.text:
This ceramic jug appears to be able to hold a gallon of liquid and weighs 12 pounds whether full or empty. Sloshing sounds can be heard from within the jug when it is shaken, even if the jug is empty.

Once per long rest, You can name one liquid from the table below to cause the jug to produce the chosen liquid. Afterward, you can uncork the jug as an action and pour that liquid out, up to 2 gallons per minute. The maximum amount of liquid the jug can produce depends on the liquid you named.

Acidpaste 8 ounces
Beer 4 gallons
Honey 1 gallon
Mayonnaise 2 gallons
Oil quart
Vinegar 2 gallons
Water, fresh 8 gallons
Water, salt 12 gallons
Wine 1 gallon

entries.name: Cloak of Displacement
entries.text: While you wear this cloak, mark a Stress to project an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. The projection lasts until the end of the scene. If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next rest. This property is suppressed while you are unable to move.

entries.name: Blood Scrying Crystal
entries.text: Once per session you may mark 2 Stress to see through the eyes of your target for a few seconds regardless of distance. This requires you to have a small quantity of the targets blood which will be consumed by the crystal.

entries.name: Caltrops
entries.text: You can spread these caltrops in a Very Close area around you. A creature hastening through that area must mark a Stress.

entries.name: Grapnel
entries.text: You gain advantage on action rolls to climb sheer surfaces.

entries.name: Ball Bearings
entries.text: This pouch contains perfectly smooth metal spheres.

entries.name: Box of Dragon Dust
entries.text: This snuffbox is filled with combustible powder.

entries.name: Nighthawker’s Ring
entries.text: Spend a Hope to activate the gemstone in this ring until the end of the scene. While active, the gemstone changes color to indicate the wearer’s proximity to hidden treasure: warm colors for near, cool colors for far.

entries.name: Elven Spyglass
entries.text: You can use this spyglass to magnify your vision a hundredfold.

entries.name: Gourmet Granules
entries.text: This savory powder makes any food it’s sprinkled on delicious and healthy, no matter how bland or rotten it is.

entries.name: Collapsible Pole
entries.text: You can break down this 18-foot pole into six interlinked 3-foot segments.

entries.name: Blackwing Quill
entries.text: This writing quill never runs out of ink or needs to be sharpened.

entries.name: Silee’s Folding Knife
entries.text: This 3-inch blade has an edge that easily cuts through anything except the handle it’s stored in.

entries.name: Windup Toy
entries.text: This small mechanical device is shaped like a strixwolf pup and can be programmed to perform simple tricks.

entries.name: Loaded Dice
entries.text: You can choose what result this set of weighted dice rolls with a successful Finesse Roll (14). If you roll with Fear, anyone watching knows the dice are loaded.

entries.name: Hollowbark Horn
entries.text: You can blow this horn to summon a small woodland creature to perform a simple task.

entries.name: Self-Tying Rope
entries.text: You can command this rope to tie or untie itself.

entries.name: Thief’s Compass
entries.text: This compass points the way toward the nearest exit while indoors and the closest entrance while outdoors.

entries.name: Traveler’s Bell
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can ring this bell to magically open the shortest safe path through rough terrain for 1 hour.

entries.name: Mandragorian Torch
entries.text: This torch gives off light only the bearer can see.

entries.name: Boots of Supple Mystique
entries.text: While wearing these boots, you don’t leave tracks or footprints.

entries.name: Zephyr’s Jar
entries.text: You can open this empty jar during inclement weather to capture the storm and leave behind clear skies. The storm remains inside until unleashed by reopening the jar.

entries.name: Returning Ring
entries.text: When you throw your primary weapon while wearing this ring, the weapon appears in your hand immediately after the attack.

entries.name: Kingfisher’s Net
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can use this net to scoop one live fish out of any amount of water, no matter how unlikely it is for that water to have fish in it.

entries.name: Titan’s Girdle
entries.text: Once per scene, you can activate this girdle to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for your next attack.

entries.name: Iron Veil
entries.text: This chain-link head covering renders the wearer invisible to fey creatures.

entries.name: Furball Bag
entries.text: Once per rest, you can produce 2d20 harmless, cat-sized fur creatures of indeterminate origin and species from this bag.

entries.name: Whisperstep Anklet
entries.text: This anklet makes your steps silent as long as you don’t move faster than walking speed.

entries.name: Enchanter’s Loupe
entries.text: You can use this loupe to see through illusions and enchantments.

entries.name: Escher’s Mirrorball
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can command this fist-sized silver orb to capture an omnidirectional image of its surroundings on its surface. This image lasts until your next long rest.

entries.name: Cheater’s Coin
entries.text: When you flip this coin, you can spend a Hope to determine which side it lands on.

entries.name: Gravewarden’s Bell
entries.text: This bell rings when a ghost or undead creature moves within Far range of it.

entries.name: Reliquary of the Sightless Saint
entries.text: You gain a +1 bonus to your Hope Die when you make the Risk It All death move.

entries.name: Map of Revelation
entries.text: You can attune this map to one creature at a time. The map always shows the attuned creature’s location.

entries.name: Dagginae’s Obsidian Slate
entries.text: This wafer-thin sheet of volcanic glass is used by archivists to keep notes. Any information etched onto its surface disappears but can be recalled via a command you set.

entries.name: Gadiman’s Backpack
entries.text: Once per rest, you can spend a Hope to conjure a mundane item up to a cubic foot in size inside this satchel.

entries.name: Eclipse Coin
entries.text: Once per rest, flip a coin. On heads, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls until your next successful attack. On tails, you gain +1 to your Evasion until an attack fails against you.

entries.name: Sorcerer’s Hat
entries.text: This conical blue hat is covered in silver stars. Once per rest, you can cast a spell from your vault with a Recall Cost equal to or less than your tier. This doesn’t work for permanently vaulted cards.

entries.name: Ghoulskin Gloves
entries.text: When you attack with a physical weapon while wearing these gloves, the damage is considered both physical and magic.

entries.name: Gloves of Alacrity
entries.text: When you would mark a Stress to reload a weapon, you don’t mark it.

entries.name: Insomniac’s Periapt
entries.text: When you take a rest without clearing Hit Points or Stress, you gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls until your next rest.

passives.label: +2 attack/damage if no HP or Stress was cleared

effect.name: Attack and Damage +2
effect.text: If you clear no HP or Stress during a rest, gain +2 to attack and damage rolls until the next rest.

entries.name: Wildrider’s Saddle
entries.text: This saddle grants any animal it’s strapped onto the ability to understand their rider’s commands.

entries.name: Soul-Twin Circlets
entries.text: Two creatures can wear this pair of circlets. You can spend a Hope to switch places with whoever is wearing the other circlet.

entries.name: Namer’s Oracle
entries.text: Once per session, you can roll this set of runic dice to reveal the full name of the last person you touched.

entries.name: Crucible Frames
entries.text: These eyeglasses reveal weak points in objects and creatures. Three times per rest, you can spend a Hope to gain advantage on an attack roll.

entries.name: Two-Faced Aegis Brooch
entries.text: Once per rest, flip a coin. On heads, you become immune to the next physical damage you take. On tails, you become immune to the next magic damage you take.

entries.name: Knockback Bracelets
entries.text: On a successful weapon attack, you can knock your target back up to Close range from their location.

entries.name: Force Disc
entries.text: This shimmering two-dimensional disc of magical force has a 4-foot diameter and is magically tethered to a pebble. The disc always floats 3 feet north of, and at the same elevation as, the pebble. The pebble has a mass equal to one-hundredth of the total mass carried by the disc.

entries.name: Molepaw Mittens
entries.text: Spend a Hope to swim through earth as if it were water for the next 10 minutes.

entries.name: Timekeeper’s Pendant
entries.text: You can choose an additional downtime move each rest.

entries.name: Iron Dagger Pendant
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can spend a Hope to tell the pendant a creature’s name. The pendant gently pulls you toward that creature’s current location until your next long rest.

entries.name: Collar of Ascendancy
entries.text: An animal who wears this collar gains the ability to speak and understand common speech.

entries.name: Temporal Sanctuary
entries.text: A PC who takes a rest in the temporal sanctuary can choose an additional downtime move.

entries.name: Hero’s Helm
entries.text: When you critically succeed on an attack, all allies within Close range gain a Hope.

entries.name: Rings of Friendship
entries.text: Two creatures can wear this pair of rings shaped like coiled snakes. You can spend the Hope of whoever is wearing the other ring (with their permission) as if it were your own.

entries.name: Rings of Camaraderie
entries.text: Two creatures can wear this pair of wooden rings. You can mark the Stress of whoever is wearing the other ring (with their permission) as if it were your own.

entries.name: Rings of Alliance
entries.text: Two creatures can wear this pair of rose gold rings. Once per session, you can initiate a Tag Team Roll with whoever is wearing the other ring without spending Hope or counting against your session limit for Tag Team Rolls.

entries.name: Phobophage’s Circlet
entries.text: When the GM spends a Fear, roll a d4. Once per scene on a result of 4, you clear a Stress.

entries.name: Quillshawl
entries.text: If an adversary attacks you within Melee range, they must succeed on a Reaction Roll (12) or mark a Hit Point.

entries.name: Warp Pendant
entries.text: Once per rest, mark a Stress to teleport to a location you can clearly see.

entries.name: Portal Frames
entries.text: This pair of small ornate frames, one red and one blue, are connected. Anything that passes into one exits from the other.

entries.name: Communion Relic
entries.text: Once per rest, you can spend a Hope to use an ally’s Experience as if it were your own. You can carry only one relic.

entries.name: Augur’s Relic
entries.text: Once per long rest, you can activate your Hope feature without spending Hope. You can carry only one relic.

entries.name: Songbook of cursed carols
entries.text: Spend a Hope to gain +2 on a roll to use fire, or to influence someone else’s mind. If the effect is from the Codex Domain, roll 1d6. On a result of 4 or higher, you regain the Hope you spent to activate this item.

rollOptions.label: Cursed carol
rollOptions.description: Only using fire or influencing a mind. For Codex effects roll refund d6 manually (4+ regains Hope).

entries.name: Dancing remains
entries.text: Throw the remains within Very Close range and make an Agility or Presence Roll (10). On a success, you make them dance, giving them a resemblence of life until they take damage or until the end of the scene. When a creature within Very Close range of the remains makes a roll, spend a Hope to force them to make it with disadvantage, and forcing them to mark a Stress on a failure. A creature within Very Close range of the remains with all Stress marked starts Dancing, using their movement to move in a random direction whenever they have the spotlight.

entries.name: Mask of the dead court
entries.text: While wearing the mask, you look like a healthy, young member of your species, hiding any Transformation, curse or affliction you might have from mundane or magical detection. Whenever something would detect or reveal your true nature, you can make a Presence Reaction roll to prevent it. If you succeed and the GM spent Fear to attempt it, they gain it back.

entries.name: Mask of the Dance Master
entries.text: The mask gains a token when a living creature dies within Melee range of the mask (maximum four tokens). Spend a token while wearing the mask to gain a +1 to your Hope die on a Death Move, or on a roll to prevent or remove an affliction, contagion, or condition related to you health.
